claim: For the v0.4 four-plan three-tick prefix fixture, public deterministic codebook adaptation to common decoded history has the exact finite Bellman frontier V_n(b)=min_a[r(a)+sum_i p_i V_{n-1}(b-w_i(a))]. It strictly beats fixed scheduling at two blocks with (57/16,5), and a guarded Huffman policy with ceil(log2 n) write slack attains the closed asymptotic rectangle [7/12,infinity) x [2/3,infinity) per tick. More generally, every finite positive i.i.d. plan alphabet has adaptive per-block lower corner (mu,ceil(log2 m)), and bounded causal fast-code processes with negative almost-sure surplus admit the same corner without a uniform one-step MGF.
finite_optimal_policy: canonical Huffman at positive residual slack; balanced at zero residual slack

finite_iid_alphabet_theorem.plans: any finite m>=2 with a positive i.i.d. law
finite_iid_alphabet_theorem.read_threshold: mu = minimum expected binary prefix length
finite_iid_alphabet_theorem.normalization: per source block on an externally registered fixed clock

conditional_mgf_guard.criterion: E[lambda^(ell_t-q) | common history] <= 1 uniformly for some lambda>1
conditional_mgf_guard.write_slack_with_threshold_a: at most a+L-q-1 when L>q; no guard is needed when L<=q

vanishing_maximum_guard.criterion: S_t/t -> h-q < 0 almost surely with bounded code lengths
vanishing_maximum_guard.read_penalty_rate: at most q*P(sup_t S_t >= a_n), which tends to zero

stationary_ergodic_separator.conditional_code: Huffman lengths (1,2,3,3) are optimal at every state

stationary_predictor_theorem.source: stationary ergodic full-support plans with a common sufficient predictive state
stationary_predictor_theorem.read_threshold: h_H = E[minimum conditional expected binary prefix length]
stationary_predictor_theorem.guard_condition: ergodic Huffman length mean below the fixed-length threshold; equality uses the fixed code

variable_support_theorem.source: finite strongly connected public unifilar predictor with positive enabled-plan laws
variable_support_theorem.write_threshold: rho = positional prefix-code mean-payoff game value
